caveats: No full host tree exists in this repository.
No full R-M result exists in this repository.
Missing or failed evidence is never promoted to biological absence.
Raw components remain unreviewed until a human checks them; they are not auto-partial.
Predicted systems are not experimental restriction activity.

stages.title: Recorded input panel
stages.description: Track the intended recorded177 genome panel in 10 groups with no Enterococcus additions or substitutions.

stages.title: Annotated proteomes
stages.description: Carry forward only annotated proteomes derived from the selected assemblies.

stages.title: Conserved single-copy markers
stages.description: Derive host-tree inputs from conserved single-copy marker proteins independently of R-M annotations.

stages.title: Per-family alignments
stages.description: Create separate alignments for each conserved marker family and keep them isolated through review.

stages.title: Per-family trimming
stages.description: Trim each alignment separately so that no fabricated combined result appears before validation.

stages.title: Concatenation packet
stages.description: Concatenate only verified per-family outputs for the host-tree branch.

stages.title: IQ-TREE host tree
stages.description: Infer the host tree from concatenated conserved-marker alignments, not from R-M calls.

stages.title: Ordered per-replicon packet
stages.description: Prepare ordered per-replicon protein and coordinate input separately for the R-M branch.

stages.title: DefenseFinder R-M candidates
stages.description: Run DefenseFinder on the ordered per-replicon packet and keep predictions separate from host-tree inference.

stages.title: Locus / REBASE / primary-paper review
stages.description: Review candidate loci with REBASE and primary-paper checks; missing or failed components are not equivalent to absence.

stages.title: Release gates
stages.description: Check that scope, receipts, and reviewer approvals are explicit before any public release step is described.

stages.title: Four R-M rings
stages.description: Export Type I, Type II (including IIG), Type III, and Type IV rings only after verified upstream review.
